name: cloudml-eval-ops
summary: Execute frozen Eval Harness rows on CloudML through official lifecycle and storage tools with durable receipts and verified collection.

mcp.boundary_notes: This maintainer skill orchestrates execution of existing eval rows. It does not add robot capabilities, task strategy, provider substitution, or private evaluator truth.

capability_requirements.notes: Requires an existing CML context, official cml resource/train commands, executor storage operations, pinned images/assets, and the capabilities declared by each selected eval row.

refactor_signals: agents repeatedly implement the same manifest merge or identity validation logic
unattended scheduling requires a stable non-agent control loop
the official cml or executor ownership boundary changes
